## MARKET SUMMARY

## INDIA

The India market has softened this week, with sentiment under pressure due to the rising exchange rate and a more cautious economic outlook. Buyers remain less inclined to commit at current levels, as higher day-to-day costs, slower construction activity and weaker steel demand continue to affect overall buying appetite.
